card.name: The .com ending inside web addresses
card.fires_on: The '.com' piece of a web address right after a site name such as youtube, facebook, tinyurl or itunes.apple. Weaker and scattered on a few other linking words like 'to' and 'of'.

modes.label: .com in URLs
modes.description: The .com that follows a site name inside a pasted link, usually in a citation or reference.

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Weak firing on words like 'to', 'of' or 'time' after an adjective or participle.
